text:
Priya Nair: Reposting a small flake that surfaced in payments-sample: when the SDK refreshes OAuth mid-stream the Node client reconnects immediately and we sometimes create duplicate invoices. Minimal trace below.

Ben Wallace: Can you paste the trace? hosted/dedicated?

Priya Nair: Hosted, us-east. Trace: 
```
[2026-03-24T14:21:05Z] start stream req=rq_223 user=acct_9
[2026-03-24T14:21:06Z] oauth refresh -> new token
[2026-03-24T14:21:06Z] client reconnect attempt=0 (no delay)
[2026-03-24T14:21:06Z] server saw payload fingerprint=fp_x1 twice
[2026-03-24T14:21:07Z] invoice inv_88 created for fp_x1
```
Leads to double-charge.

Iris Park: Classic unsafe replay. Do we attach any idempotency or replay header for streaming in Node?

Priya Nair: Node streaming helper didn't. Python accidentally attached Idempotency-Key so it didn't show up there.

Marcus Lee: Proposed quick fixes: 1) client: add small randomized reconnect jitter (e.g., uniform 50-300ms) and route reconnects through retry backoff path (full jitter). 2) client: include lightweight replay header `x-redwood-replay-id` (UUID) at stream start. 3) server: short-lived tombstone keyed by replay-id for 20-30s to dedupe.

Ben Wallace: For backoff, let's standardize: full-jitter with base=150ms cap=30s: sleep=random(0, base*2^attempt). Important that auth-rotation reconnects count as attempts.

Iris Park: We'll need SDK toggle flags: `streaming.replayGuard=true` default and `streaming.replayJitter={min,max}` so teams can opt-out. Also add unit/integration tests simulating token rotation mid-stream.

Priya Nair: I added a failing e2e in payments-sample: tests/stream_token_rotation.spec.ts. CI shows flake. ci-bot: sampleapp-e2e #1204 failed: stream_token_rotation.spec.ts (1 failed).

Marcus Lee: Server tombstone sketch: Redis key `replay:<uuid>` -> fingerprint, invoice_id TTL 25s using SETNX; if exists return 409 or a resume token. Watch memory for high-traffic endpoints; maybe adaptive TTL under contention.

Ben Wallace: Telemetry: emit `replay.received`, `replay.duplicate`, `replay.charge_blocked`. That'll let us measure benefit. Also detect client versions not sending header so we can inform customers.

Iris Park: Action owners: Node SDK (Marcus) add header+jitter; Runtime (Ben) prototype tombstone + metrics; Sampleapp (Priya) keep e2e and flake guard; Docs (Iris) short guidance. Can owners ack?

Marcus Lee: ack — will open Node PR today, include config and tests.

Ben Wallace: ack — will spin up a small perf test against dev cluster for tombstone memory characteristics.

Iris Park: ack — will draft docs and sample code.

Priya Nair: Thanks. I'll paste the repro dir link when I push. If anyone sees other clients (websocket, mobile) doing different reconnect behavior, ping me.
